agentic_options.custom_prompt: This is a national clinical and public health guideline. Reconstruct every table as a Markdown table, keeping every row, every column and every number exactly as printed (doses, mg/kg, weight bands, age bands, volumes, units). Give each table exactly ONE header row: when the printed table has two header rows or merged header cells, join them into each column's header (e.g. 'Volume per feed (ml): every 2 hours (12 feeds)'), never as a data row. Transcribe flowcharts, algorithms and decision diagrams as nested Markdown lists that follow the boxes and arrows, keeping every box's text and every branch condition (yes/no, cut-offs). Describe charts and graphs as a table of their values plus one sentence on what they show. Keep heading levels as in the document. Do not add anything that is not on the page.
